purpose: Complete the preregistered correct-acceptance comparison now that the primary D source rank provided a small positive signal. Compare actual independently generated D and original frozen D winners. Record original Top-1 retention as a descriptive paired outcome and evaluate the actual gate on correct accepted counts, separately.
fixed: Keep the same frozen candidate pool, scores and fold budgets. Fit the eight-dimensional fixed prior actual-winner readout independently for original D and new evidence D, using the same verified expression labels, balanced logistic penalty 0.15 and probability cutoff 0.5.
test: Within every outer calibration subset, fit each inner unsplit recording group without its own data. Refit the scalar B and the D head only inside that inner calibration scope. No outer test rank or reliability labels enter training. Compute test labels globally blinded to the confidence and split.
correct_acceptance_check: At the same fixed rejection threshold, evaluate predicted errors and accepted correct outputs. Compare combined and each Waymo panel, and report the number of missed or newly verified competitors. A reliable path must keep at least the pooled original frozen D correct output count and improve identification over the appearance and misaligned controls. No study promotion from one panel alone.
replication: Same data, objectives, feature masks, fold splits and optimization parameters. One independently predeclared alternative seed given by 311119 plus fold ordinal for all four heads. The primary seed 251119 plus fold ordinal remains the preregistered result and is never replaced by choosing a better seed.
